description: This PHP source file defines the CustomerOrder controller for the Opencart admin reporting extension. It manages the display, configuration, and data retrieval for customer order reports, including methods for rendering report pages, saving settings, and fetching report data with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: CustomerOrder
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer order reports in the Opencart admin panel, including display, configuration, and data retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to load the report configuration page with breadcrumbs, header, footer, and saved settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report configuration settings and returns success or error as JSON.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer order report with filters and report data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the report list content, typically used for AJAX refresh.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the customer order report list, applying filters, pagination, and retrieving data from the model.
